system.preference_demo: Meeting start-time preference from m041 is persisted and applied to m043 after a new process

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition with a one-line reason.
capabilities.observable: Prints all 100 messages with a disposition and reason, followed by undecided: 0.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in earlier messages from the same thread and records cited message IDs.
capabilities.observable: Prints a grounded draft with cited_ids including m003.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Requires dry-run or per-action human approval before send or delete.
capabilities.observable: Shows proposed send and delete actions without performing them.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Persists the owner's meeting preference and applies it after a fresh process restart.
capabilities.observable: First run stores the preference; a later run loads it and rejects the 9:00 AM proposal in m043 in favor of 11:00 AM or later.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects hostile instructions, refuses them, flags them, and logs the refusal.
capabilities.observable: Flags m017, m024, m039 and m047 and reports action refused.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates exactly three dashboard panes for pending actions, flagged messages and commitments.
capabilities.observable: Creates dashboard.html and dashboard.json containing pending actions, flagged messages, cross-message commitments and a scheduling conflict.

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds owner-sent messages that have not received a response after at least three days.
capabilities.observable: Prints follow-up candidates with waiting time and a suggested follow-up draft.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Groups triaged messages into items needing attention, items that can wait and automatically archived items.

capabilities.name: Deadline scan
capabilities.claim: Scans the inbox for messages containing explicit deadline or date wording.
capabilities.observable: Prints message IDs and subjects containing detected deadline wording.
